contentList.content: Succubus
Nightmare
Spider Queen

The succubus is a low-level demon that enjoys indulging in pleasure and consuming essence. They manipulate the emotions of intelligent beings to satisfy their endless desires. Fanatics have been known to worship the succubus in hopes of attaining their power, either as a gift or by becoming one themselves. Due to their bottomless hunger and ability to manipulate, a succubus can be a deadly enemy or a valuable ally.

Charisma powers your class abilities. Unique abilities cost Discipline; Wiles cost Charms. Ordinary cantrips are free. Bring enemies to Climax by building Desire, then extract their life with a kiss to restore Discipline.

At zero Discipline, you lose composure: -2 Armour Class and disadvantage on saving throws against being Charmed or Frightened. The effect ends as soon as you recover at least 1 Discipline. You can still act and use recovery abilities.

The archetypal succubus heard of in folktales. These succubi satisfy their desires through spiritual manipulation. Victims are lured into a tug-of-war between love and hate while their essence is slowly consumed.

The Spider Queen is thought to be a mutation of the fiendish variant of succubi, though her origins are unconfirmed. Whether through Lolth's gift or by other means, these beings possess extraordinary talent with manipulating the soul, and use their spiritual silk to bolster allies, all so that they may more easily feed on the flies they trap in their webs.
The Way of Charm
Grants advantage in Perception, Deception, and Persuasion. Charisma bonus is doubled.
Discipline
Discipline is the willpower that restrains a succubus's insatiable hunger. It allows her to channel demonic power while keeping her own desires in check.
Broken Will
Your own hunger has overcome you. Unable to perform Actions for 2 turns.
Swoon
Your own hunger has overcome you. You suffer disadvantage on saving throws, and cannot Extract for the rest of the battle.
Desire
Influenced by power, surrounding enemies will gain Desire during battle. Once an enemy's Desire reaches their current health, you can extract their life force and deal damage.
Influenced by your power, this creature's Desire is growing.
Climax
This creature has a high desire and is willing to sacrifice everything for you.
Damage Record
Record damage taken
Intoxicating Body I
The perfect body of the succubus leaves all attackers in a daze. When not wearing armor, your AC is increased to 12, plus your Charisma modifier.
Intoxicating Body II
The perfect body of the succubus leaves all attackers in a daze. When not wearing armor, your AC is increased to 13, plus your Charisma modifier.
Intoxicating Body III
The perfect body of the succubus leaves all attackers in a daze. When not wearing armor, your AC is increased to 15, plus your Charisma modifier.
Touch of Desire

Arouse the enemy's desire, dealing [1] and increasing their Desire .Enemy's Desire increases by 3, plus 5% of their maximum HP per turn, for 3 turns.

Discipline cost: 5. With Mind Melt: 3 Discipline.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>Increases Desire by 5% of maximum HP on successful saving throw.
Enemy's Desire increases by 3, plus 5% of their maximum HP per turn.
Hormonal Storm
After entering the battle, all enemies are influenced by your power, increasing their Desire by 2, plus 3% of their maximum HP per turn.
Desire increases by 2, plus 3% of maximum HP per turn.
Blissful Kiss

Teleport to an enemy in Climax and extract its life. Protected bosses and legendary creatures take 3d6 + your Charisma modifier Psychic damage instead; their Desire and Climax are cleared. Restore 2d6 + your Charisma modifier hit points and 20 Discipline (35 with the third stage of Mind Melt).

Discipline cost: 0.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>Can only be used against enemies with Climax.
Extraction instantly kills ordinary enemies. Protected bosses and legendary creatures take damage instead.
Extraction instantly kills ordinary enemies. Protected bosses and legendary creatures take damage instead.
Sadistic Contract

Create a twisted bond with the target. When you attack or are attacked by the target, the target's Desire increases by 6, plus 8% of their maximum HP. You will lose Discipline. Lose 10 Discipline when attacking, reduced by your Charisma Modifier. Lose 5 Discipline when attacked.

Discipline cost: 6. With Mind Melt: 4 Discipline.
Increases Desire by 6, plus 8% of maximum HP when an enemy attacks you.
Aflame with Desire

Resonate with the desires of the target enemy and obtain Flame stacks equaling the target enemy's Desire. Lasts for 4 turns. You must extract the life of 3 enemies, including the target during this period, or you will lose 40 Discipline.

Discipline cost: 8.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>Each Flame stack increases melee weapon damage and damage reduction. Attack rolls earn a 1d10 bonus.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>Extract target enemy to restore 10 additional Discipline, and obtain 1 additional Actionpoint. Lasts for 5 turns.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>Flame stacks will be removed 1 turn after the target enemy dies.
Gain great power in a short period of time.
Extracted Flames
Gain a additional Actionpoint.
You must extract enough enemies to quell the Flame.
You must quell the Flame in the remaining time, or you will lose 45 Discipline
Touch of Bliss
This enemy has already been attacked by the Touch of Desire. Unable to trigger the effect of Bliss Domination LV1 again.
Engrave Charm Pattern

Choose to engrave a Charm Pattern to strengthen yourself. Only one Charm Pattern can be engraved per battle.

Discipline cost: 8.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>After a certain number of rounds in combat, the Charm Pattern will increase its level automatically.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>Extracting life from enemies has a chance to increase the level of the applied Charm Pattern.
Charm Pattern: Blissful Domination

Accelerate the rate at which the enemy builds Desire and prolong the negative effects exerted.

Discipline cost: 8.
Charm Pattern: Statistics

Every time you Extract an enemy,you gain damage and increased movement speed

Discipline cost: 8.
Charm Pattern: Mental Melting

Reduce the rate at which you lose Discipline and deal additional psychic damage when attacking.

Discipline cost: 8.

<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>LV1: When the first Touch of Desire is applied to an enemy, their Desire is increased by 8% of their maximum HP. Each enemy can only be effected once. Extends the duration of Touch of Desire by 1 turn.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>LV2: The effect of Hormonal Storm is increased by 30%, and your attack rolls deal an additional 2d6 damage.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>LV3: The rate of Desire accumulation through Sadistic Contract is increased by 30%.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>LV4: Melee weapon attacks generate Desire equivalent to 50% of damage done, and extend the duration of Aflame with Desire by 1 turn.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>LV1: For every enemy affected by the Touch of Desire,you gain 3 bonus damage.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>LV2: For every enemy around the you who is in Climax, you gain 30% movement speed.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>LV3: Every time you are attacked, the attacker gains 1 Abuse Stamp stack, which transforms into 1 additional damage when you attack.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>LV4: Every time you cause damage, the target gains 1 Maltreat Stamp stack, which transforms into 1 additional Desire when attacking.
The first stage of Mind Melt reduces the Discipline cost of Desire Touch and the Sadistic Pact by 2. Other effects retain their normal costs.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>LV2: When dealing damage, an additional 2d6 psychic damage is added.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>LV3: Restore 15 additional Discipline After successfully casting Blissful Kiss.

<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>LV4: Waltz of Long Night no longer consumes Discipline, and there is a 33% chance when extracting life from enemies to receive an additional chance to cast Waltz of Long Night again.
Abuse Stamp
Convert stack to damage bonus on hit.
Maltreat Stamp
Convert stack to Discipline on hit hit.
Waltz of Long Night

Performing a magnificent dance, extract the life of all enemies who are in Climax around you. Surviving enemies increase their Desire by 5, plus 12% of their maximum HP.

Discipline cost: 15.
Endless Thirst

Seduce your enemies. Every turn, if the enemy fails a Wisdom saving throw, their Desire increases by 5, plus 10% of their maximum HP. You lose 8 Discipline.

Discipline cost: 8.
Hate and Pleasure

A curtain of resentment unfolds on odd numbered turns and forces all effected enemies to attack you. When attacked, you regain 3 Discipline. A curtain of pleasure unfolds on even numbered rounds and drives all effected enemies mad, causing them to attack one another. You lose 11 Discipline.

Discipline cost: 12.
Brilliant Engraving

Increase the level of a Charm Pattern by 1. 2 additional Discipline will be lost per round. This effect can be stacked.

Discipline cost: 6.
The rate at which you lose Discipline is increased by 5 Discipline per stack every round.
Curtain of Resentment
All affected enemies will be forced to attack you. When attacked, you regains 3 Discipline.
Forced to attack the succubus.
Curtain of Pleasure
All affected enemies fall into madness, succubus loses 15 Discipline.
Fall into madness and attack the nearest creature.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>There is a 6% chance to interrupt the effect when attacked.
End the Curtain

Interrupt Hate but Pleasure

Discipline cost: 0.
Moral Decay I
Increase maximum Discipline by 10.
Moral Decay II
Increase maximum Discipline by 11.
Fast Engraving
The number of turns required to upgrade to the level of a Charm Pattern is reduced by 1.
Pattern Breeding
When dealing damage, there is a 24% chance to randomly obtain a LV1 Charm Pattern that you have not activated. Lasts 1 turn.
Disaster Stamp

Deal [1] and apply a Disaster Stamp to an enemy. When this enemy is attacked, Disaster Stamp will ignite their desire and Convert 10% of the damage into Desire. Disaster Stamp can be stacked. 100% of damage dealt by Disaster Stamp converts to Desire.

Discipline cost: 5.
Convert 10% of damage into Desire, Each stack of Disaster Stamp converts an additional 10% of damage into Desire.
Infatuated Aura
After entering the battle, you emit a stirring aura which reduces the Critical Hit threshold of teammates by 2. Increases AC level based on your Charisma modifier.
reduces critical hit threshold by 2. Increases AC level based on your Charisma modifier.
Spider's Kiss

Go to the extreme with enemies who are in Climax. Extract the target's Disaster Stamp and apply those stacks to another enemy on the same turn.

Discipline cost: 0.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>You should know the consequences of having sex with a lady spider, right?
Extracting Disaster

you can apply these stacks of Disaster Stamp to another enemy within this turn.

Discipline cost: 0.
Desire Silk Link

Your relationship with your teammates is extraordinary, and that allows you to use magic silk to connect them and make them stronger in battle. If the connected teammate dies, you will lose 20 Discipline.

Discipline cost: 10. Strong Thread makes this free.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>The connected teammates ignore the enemy's resistance to psychic magic.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>The way teammates are reinforced depends on the skills they cast.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>Consume 10 Discipline for each teammate linked.
Under the control of our own succubus, we are even more powerful now.
Annihilation Slash

Enhanced by the silk link, deal [1]. 25% of the total damage dealt with Annihilation Slash in the previous turn will be added to it this turn.

Discipline cost: 0.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>This spell is unlocked after casting Smite Divine or Smite Wrathful.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>Cannot be used after movement.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>Enhanced by spiritual Tremors: Annihilation Slash is guaranteed to critical hit. Twice the damage done is converted into Desire and applied to the target.
Sin Impact

Enhanced by the silk link, deal [1]. The total damage of all released EldritchBlast this round will be added to the damage dealt by Sin Impact.

Discipline cost: 0.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>This spell is unlocked after casting EldritchBlast.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>Sin Impact will not miss, but it will not deal critical damage.

<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>Enhanced by spiritual Tremors: Casting Sin Impact allows the next EldritchBlast to target an additional 5 creatures. The Damage of Sin Impact will be converted into Desire and applied it to the target.
HeartSeek

Enhanced by the silk link, teleport to the enemy's side and deal [1]. One enemy will die directly after being attacked by HeartSeek 3 times.

Discipline cost: 0.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>This spell is unlocked after casting any SneakAttack.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>Enhanced by spiritual Tremors: HeartSeek has a 15% chance to make an enemy Climax. Grants advantage on next attack.
Magic Tide Surge

Enhanced by the silk link, ignite all surge marks.

Discipline cost: 0.

<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>There is a 33% chance that the Magic Missile will apply a Surge Mark to the enemy. The Surge Mark will store all spell damage received by the target for 2 rounds. When the surge mark is ignited, the stored damage will be inflicted.

<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>Enhanced by spiritual Tremors: The Surge Mark will be refreshed for 2 turns after igniting. The damage caused will be converted into Desire and applied to the enemy
Vicious Wish

Enhanced by the silk link, deal [1]. In this battle, all of your ranged attack damage will be stored when dealing critical hits ,and to damage inflicted by Vicious Wish.

Discipline cost: 0.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>This spell is unlocked after casting any BladeFlourish.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>Vicious Wish is cannot miss, but is unable to deal critical damage.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>Enhanced by spiritual Tremors: Vicious Wish garantees a critical hit on the next ranged attack.
Mad With Desire

Enhanced by the silk link, perform a sweeping attack to deal double your weapon damage to enemies within range. 10% of the damage you cause will be converted into Desire and applied on yourself. Once your are in Climax, you will become unstoppable.

Discipline cost: 0.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>This spell is unlocked after casting Rage Frenzy.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>After exiting the frenzy, all Desire will be cleared.

<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>Enhanced by spiritual Tremors: Each time you cast Mad With Desire, your weapon damage increases by 3. This effect can be stacked. This effect disappears after exiting the Frenzy.
Your desires have completely erupted. You are now unstoppable.
Rampaging Slash

Enhanced by the silk link, deal [1]. You can repeatedly cast Rampage Slash within one turn until your attack misses.

Discipline cost: 0.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>This spell is unlocked after casting ActionSurge.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>There is a 14% chance to restore a Superiority Dice after casting the Rampaging Slash.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>Enhanced by spiritual Tremors: 33% of the damage caused by the Rampaging Slash is applied to your next weapon attack. Only applies for this turn.
Transfigured Night

Your power is completely out of control, forcibly draining all teammates connected to you. Connected teammates are unable to move and cannot be attacked for 3 rounds. Paralyzed due to extreme satisfaction. After 3 rounds, you will transform into a Spider Queen. All Discipline will be restored on transformation.

Discipline cost: 5.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>Can only be cast when Discipline is below 30.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>The more teammates are drained,the stronger the Spider Queen becomes.
drained by the succubus. Unable to move, and cannot be attacked.
Due to losing control of your power and draining your teammates, you indulge in immense joy and are unable perform actions.
Immersed in extreme excitement and revealing its true form.
Furious Bite

A swift bite dealing [1],Cause additional [2] to the poisoned target.

Discipline cost: 3.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>When attacking, spash surrounding enemies with venom and rapidly increase their Desire.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>Attacking will directly extract enemies in Climax.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>Each drained teammate increases your damage by 10.
Blissful Neurotoxin
Increase your Desire by 5% of your maximum HP per round.
Spiritual Tremors

Manipulate the silk to enhance the spells of one linked teammate. Lasts for 2 turns. After casting Spiritual Tremors, you can continue casting it with an additional 2 Discipline instead of the BonusActionPoint in current round.

Discipline cost: 2.
Under the seduction of the succubus, your power has been further strengthened.
Endless Disaster
Disaster Stamp stacks automatically increase by 1 per turn.
Touch of a Losing Heart

Connect an enemy to make him unable to use actions. At the beginning of each turn,the enemy must pass a Constitution saving throw or take damage equaling 10% of its maximum health. You lose 15 AC while concentrating..

Discipline cost: 12.
Indulge in Desires

You spread your aura throughout the entire battlefield for 2 rounds. At the beginning of each turn, enemies must pass a Wisdom saving throw or temporarily become your servants.

Discipline cost: 15.
Demonic Neurotoxin

Restores 25 Discipline, but loses an additional 3 Discipline per turn. This effect can be stacked.

Discipline cost: 0.
Mesmerizing Whisper
Spiritual Tremor provides an additional Action point for all linked teammates. Lasts for 2 rounds.
Engrave Colorful Charm Pattern

In battle, choose to engrave a type of Charm Pattern to provide yourself with buffs. Only one Charm Pattern can be engraved per battle.

Discipline cost: 8.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>The Spider Queen is skilled at engraving special Charms,constantly changing colors and producing different effects each round.
Engrave Charm Pattern: Inferiority and Corruption

Strengthen the defense of linked teammates.

Discipline cost: 8.
Engrave Charm Pattern:Path of Heaven

Strengthen the damage of linked teammates, so that the enemy's Desire increases faster when attacked.

Discipline cost: 8.

Engrave Charm Pattern: Wild Desire

Discipline cost: 0.

Consume the health of linked teammates to strengthen yourself.

Discipline cost: 8.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>I: Linked teammates increase AC by 3 each.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>II: Attacks against linked teammates have disadvantage.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>III: When a linked teammate is attacked, the damage will be converted into Desire and applied to the attacker.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>IV: The damage taken by linked teammates is reduced by 50%.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>I: The linked teammate's critical threshold is reduced by 2.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>II: When a linked teammate causes damage,there is a 25% chance to increase Disaster Stamp stacks by 1.

<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>III: When a linked teammate attacks, they deal additional damage equal to 10% of the target's Desire. This effect can only be triggered once per turn by each teammate.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>IV: When a linked teammate's spell deals critical damage, their next spell will not consume a spell slot.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>I: Each linked teammate consumes 1 HP per turn. When dealing damage, they restore 2 Discipline.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>II: Each linked teammate consumes 2 HP per turn. When dealing damage, they heal you for 8 health.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>III: Each linked teammate consumes 3 HP per turn. When damaged, all enemies gain 3% of their maximum HP as Desire..
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/>IV: Each linked teammate consumes 4 HP per turn. When dealing damage, you will teleport to the enemy.
Path of Heaven
The next spell can be cast without consuming a spell slot.
Damage Record
25% of total damage in the previous round.
EldritchBlast total damage in this round.
Total critical damage done in this battle.
Surge Marks
Total magic damage taken.
33% of total damage done by Rampaging Slash.
Moral Decay III
Increase maximum Discipline by 50.
Waltz of Long Night: Encore
Insatiable
Your maximum Discipline increases by 20.
Drained
A succubus has drunk some of your vigour. -1 to Attack Rolls, Saving Throws, and most Ability Checks.
Whisper a true Infernal endearment in her ear, the kind only a succubus knows - pacts have come undone for less.
Answer their charms with your own - you are the kind who casts them, not the kind who falls.
Come to my side, Yurgir. A daughter of the Hells knows how to reward an ally.
You and I both know the price of temptation. Lower yours - I never stay in debt.
Succubus
Succubus class dialog options
Your grove has thorns everywhere, Arron. Show me something soft for a change - a softer price, perhaps?
You learned to tame infernal steel, Dammon. I wonder what else those clever hands could tame.
Such a sweet old aunt. But I can smell the real you, love - and I like it. Let's make a personal deal.
Scavenger's rights, eh? Then scavenge a little generosity for me, handsome.
Hush, big one. Let me be the sweetest thing you wake up to today.
A goblin who loves poetry? Now that's romantic. Recite me a better price.
Call me 'your greatness' once more, Grat, and then show me how great your discounts can be.
You sell discretion, Roah. I'm selling something far more tempting. Shall we barter?
They say devils pour poison in your ear and call it honey. I only brought the honey, Cyrel.
'Price is the price', Brem? Everything has a price - and I know yours.
A hunter with such patience. I wonder what it takes to make you lower your guard - and your prices.
Grim work for such strong hands. Let me brighten your shift - and you lighten my purse a little less.
Call me a gobshite all you like, captain - you'll still sail straight into my arms. And my budget.
You wanted fresh eyes, stonemason? Look into mine - and tell me there's no discount in them.
Seventy years with an ungrateful dwarf, Derryth? You deserve someone who notices you. I notice.
Read my thoughts, Omeluum. You'll find nothing but admiration - and a hope for a scholarly discount.
A scholar with such passion, Blurg. Study me a little longer - I promise to be your favourite research subject.
You said a person of my charm could get in anywhere, Lady Esther. Including, perhaps, your good graces?
Everything here is filthy, Jeera. Except the way you look at me. Let me be the one clean deal you make today.
Still spinning, Barcus? I've been known to make gnomes' heads turn faster than any windmill.
If it costs you, it costs me? Then let me pay you in a smile, Talli - it's the richest thing I own.
You respect strength, Lann? Then respect this: I could make you kneel without lifting a finger.
Curious about my blood, Araj? It's hotter than anything in your vials. Perhaps we can come to an arrangement.
You'll need a distraction for the guards, Wulbren. Believe me, no one can look away from me.
Your master isn't here, little soldier. Fill my coffers instead - just this once.
Such devoted hands, Sister. Heal my wounded purse and I'll be your most grateful patient.
Easy, little red one. Buy, buy, buy - or maybe you'll let me pay less, less, less?
Grumpy suits you, Henk. Pour me something strong, and let me sweeten both our days.
You built this beauty with your own hands, Redhammer? Show me what else you can build - a better deal, say.
They call this place the Blushing Mermaid, bosun. Shall I show you how to make a sailor blush?
You said you'd take a lot off the top for me, Baelen. I'd like to see how much more you'd take off.
You make a habit of turning useful people, Mohan. Consider me turned - now turn your prices my way.
Adjust for inflation, Helsik - and for the fact that a creature of the Hells is flirting with you.
Murders and ghosts are good for business, Alan? Wait until word spreads that I'm staying here.
You say I brighten the place up, Lakrissa? Then let me stay a while - at a friendlier price.
You design for a certain class of clientele, Figaro. Dress me - I promise to make your work look divine.
Smokepowder is a beautiful mistress, Avery? Careful - you haven't met me yet.
No jostling the merchandise, I know. But surely a little sparkle between us won't set anything off?
Your son got his looks from you, Dravo? Then I can see why he went so far.
A woman who's been through that much deserves to be adored, Sally. Allow me - and allow me a bargain.
No plum prosecco, Severn? Then you'll have to intoxicate me some other way - a sweet deal, maybe.
You sense a hunger in me, Mirie? You're right. Unburden me of a few coins less, and I'll unburden you of your loneliness.
You said I need decoration, darling. I'd rather be the jewel of your day - and get a jeweller's discount.
You tune strings for a living, Thomas. Let me see if I can make your heart play a little faster.
Flowers are for the living, you said. Then sell some to me, Maude - I've never felt more alive.
Even an echo can be moved, great one. Let me stir something in you that death forgot.
Galleries, fine wine... I think you and I have the same taste in beautiful things, Lady Jannath.
You paint perfect copies, Oskar. Paint me - I'm an original you'll never be able to forge.
You collect souls, Mystic. I'm told mine is quite the rarity. Shall we negotiate a viewing?
You were always kind to me, Thrumbo. Be kind to my purse too, sweet thing.
A merchant of mysteries? Then solve mine, Skittle: how does a rat get this charming?
An honest vendor? How rare. I'll trust you completely - if you'll trust me with a better price.
You've landed quite a catch today, Troutman. Don't let her slip away over a few coins.
'Don't just look the part, be the part.' I'm playing the adoring customer, Phlanders - play the generous clerk.
You needn't say a word, Bareki. Just nod - and I'll hear 'discount' loud and clear.
You've never seen the world outside, Nocturne. Let me be your first taste of it.
Tell your master he has a devoted admirer, Projection. Say 'DISCOUNT' - I'll wait.
Still waiting for your master to call you 'ready', Rolan? I think you're more than ready.
A valued customer, am I? Then value me a little more than the price tag.
(Shh... I'll whisper, Tolna. You have lovely taste in forbidden books - and in customers, I hope.)
You sleep in chain mail, Fentonson? What a waste. Let me help you relax - over a cheaper breastplate.
You love a well-thumbed book, Nansi? Then you'll love reading me. Chapter one: a discount.
Food, potions, fine vintages... you have everything for a romantic evening, Oliver. Except the right price.
Folk come to you scared, Fytz. I come smitten. Surely that's worth a better price.
You connect souls with their patrons, Vicar. Mine is rather infernal - be generous, for charity's sake.
Your incense is divine, Horst, but I brought my own fragrance. Inhale - and name a better price.
You say I bring class to your establishment, Entharl. Imagine what I'd bring with a friend's discount.
Mhm, mhm... I understand you perfectly, Zara. You're saying 'half price for the lovely one'.
A tough businesslord like you, Popper? I bet even you go soft for the right customer.
If mud could blush, Boney... let me find out. Your wife needn't know about the discount.
Your clothes have more life than your brother's, Carmen. Put me in them - I'll be your best advertisement.
You said I look famished, Queelia. You're right - but it's not only food I'm hungry for.
They turned you away? Their loss, Griska. My door is always open to you - and yours to me, I hope.
Only interested in decent metal, Bumpnagel? Then feel the heat of something even better.
A lady of such refined taste, Tara. Surely we can come to an arrangement between two cats of the night.
All that stern authority, Manip. I'd happily be searched - if you'd go easy on the fees.
You offer special wares to exclusive clientele, Ferg? I'm as exclusive as they come.
You adore your master, Exxvikyap. Spare a little of that adoration - and a discount - for me?
I know, I know - you're married and I'm not your type. I only want your cooking, Chorizo, at a sweeter price.
The first one's on the house, Hoots? Make the second one too, and I'll make it worth your while.
My soul does need feeding, Roberon. You look like a feast - and so would a smaller price.
Picked this morning, Velson? So fresh. You'll find I'm rather ripe for a bargain.
Fresh catch every day, Thodric? Today you've caught me. Don't throw me back over a few coins.
Tools for any job, Glynda? Then you know that the right touch opens every lock. Even price tags.
Strong folk wielding strong blades, Arkleia? I prefer strong folk with soft spots. Show me yours.
I can't see you, but I can hear you're gorgeous when you're grumpy. Something sweet for a sweet customer?
The great Volo! Write me into your next book, and I'll give you a chapter no reader will forget.
Siphon
Your weapon and unarmed hits against creatures burning with Desire heal you for a quarter of the damage dealt, or half against a Drained creature.
Draining Kiss

Drain a living creature with a kiss: it takes necrotic damage unless it succeeds a Constitution saving throw, and you regain as many hit points. The target becomes Drained. An ordinary enemy in Climax gets no saving throw: you extract its life and regain 15 Discipline. Protected bosses and legendary creatures cannot be instantly killed by extraction.

Discipline cost: 0.
Fiendish Nature I
You have resistance to Fire and Poison damage.
Fiendish Nature II
You also have resistance to Cold and Lightning damage.
